Also mention personal details integration - presumably just pass through as part of booking; but our tool doesn't accept personal details. Maybe it's implicit.

Thus steps:
1) Call get_nearest_airport_by_city twice to get codes.
2) Call get_flight_cost.
Check result. If ok, call book_flight.

Let's implement calls accordingly.
